sloka: उत्तरे सागरे सन्ध्यामुपासित्वा दशाननम् ।वहमानो ऽगमद्वाली पूर्वं वै स महोदधिम् ।। ७.३४.३१ ॥
transliteration: uttare sāgare sandhyāmupāsitvā daśānanam ।vahamāno 'gamadvālī pūrvaṁ vai sa mahodadhim ।। 7.34.31 ॥

translations.english: After performing his evening prayers in the northern ocean, Vali, still carrying Ravana, then proceeded to the eastern great ocean.
